knowledge.name: knowledge_query
knowledge.description: The host binds native task identity per call. Search graded rules and task material in the selected domain. Returns bounded navigation cards and deduplicated foundation_cards for progressive loading; each match identifies its source, has a readable ref, and returns feedback_ref for the exact observed revision. Pass known task conditions to filter graded rules; unknown conditions are excluded by default. Archived or superseded units are omitted unless include_archived is true. For related task blocks, pass related_next as continuation without query. A changed corpus rejects the continuation. Pass navigation_only to omit inline bodies. Reference material does not establish applicability.

conditions.description: Observed task facts used to check rule applicability.

domain_path.description: Preferred graded domain_path prefix; cross-directory fallback remains available.

token_budget.description: Body excerpt and inherited-rule budget in estimated tokens.

include_unknown.description: Include units whose declared conditions are unknown; unknown is not evidence of applicability.

include_archived.description: Include archived or superseded units in discovery.

navigation_only.description: Return navigation cards only; omit inline result bodies while keeping exact read costs.

run_id.description: Bind delivery and discovered events to this run for deduplicated usage accounting.

domain.description: One configured canonical knowledge domain; omit to use the installed default.

knowledge.name: knowledge_explain
knowledge.description: The host binds native task identity per call. Read a returned graded-unit, task or block ref, or assemble a batch from refs. A graded-unit ref returns its exact current revision and conditions; a task ref returns navigation and first_block_ref; a block ref returns its immutable body and adjacent block refs. Batch refs assemble the dependency closure minus known_refs, returning complete bodies with shared premises expanded once. Replaced graded revisions and withdrawn material are unavailable. Use the returned ref to read and feedback_ref to vote. Pass run_id to bind delivery events.

ref.description: Copy the graded-unit, task or block ref returned by query/explain exactly.

refs.description: Batch of graded-unit refs to assemble with dependency closure.

conditions.description: Observed task facts for closure applicability verification.

known_refs.description: Exact id@revision refs already visible in the active context.

run_id.description: Bind delivery and loaded events to this run for deduplicated usage accounting.

knowledge.name: knowledge_feedback
knowledge.description: The host binds native task identity per call. Optional: copy feedback_ref from query/explain into ref to record an up/down vote on that observed revision with an optional one-line reason. Also records the four-stage usage flywheel: discovered, loaded, applied, or evaluated (applied/evaluated bind run_id and an evaluated outcome). evaluated records how the outcome was established through evidence_source. Vote and usage event may be combined. Never required; silence is not a vote.

evidence_source.description: How an evaluated outcome was established; defaults to an agent declaration.

knowledge.name: knowledge_distill
knowledge.description: The host binds native task identity per call. Explicitly distill caller-selected, already-authorized evidence into graded knowledge. task_state is supplied by the caller; ordinary Stop never selects completion. Pass related_refs to compare against existing units for a milestone/delta proposal; pass a mindie-distill-decision/1 proposal to apply deterministic validation with no model call. The host binds native task identity and the active lease. May invoke the configured native organizer once and apply a returned C6 decision locally; no GitHub write.

domain.description: One configured canonical knowledge domain; omit to use the installed default.

diagnose_connection.description: Compare SSH connections with a fixed read-only probe; never replays a business command.

inputSchema.description: Provide at least one endpoint selector: host and port together, or an alias from the endpoint alias files. The server validates the selector before connecting.

remote.name: remote_exec_command
remote.description: General remote tool for every native Codex task; no MindIE activation needed. The host binds native task identity per call; one task cannot reach another task's remote jobs. Runs a command in a PTY, returning output or a session ID for ongoing interaction (Codex exec_command).

inputSchema.description: Provide at least one endpoint selector: host and port together, or an alias from the endpoint alias files. The server validates the selector before connecting.

host.description: SSH host; must be given together with port unless alias is used.

port.description: SSH port; must be given together with host unless alias is used.

container.description: Existing Docker container name or ID on the SSH host. All tools operate inside it; results return a full ID for reuse without another name lookup. No provisioning or managed allocation.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller connection limit in milliseconds; omitted by default.

runtime_env_file.description: Remote profile script sourced before commands when runtime_env is true.

alias.description: Name from the endpoint alias files.

workdir.description: Working directory on the remote endpoint (not a local path). Defaults to the endpoint cwd/root.

tty.description: True allocates a PTY; false or omitted uses plain pipes.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Defaults to 10000 ms; effective range 250-30000 ms.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

shell.description: Shell binary executed on the remote endpoint; omitted uses bash.

login.description: Run the selected remote shell with -l; native default true.

environment_id.description: Environment id; remote-dev supports only the primary environment.

remote.name: remote_write_stdin
remote.description: General remote tool for every native Codex task; no MindIE activation needed. The host binds native task identity per call; one task cannot reach another task's remote jobs. Writes characters to an existing unified exec session and returns recent output (Codex write_stdin).

inputSchema.description: Endpoint selector fields are optional for this tool: the endpoint is recovered from the stored job record. Supply host and port together, or an alias, only to override or when no job record exists.

host.description: SSH host; must be given together with port unless alias is used.

port.description: SSH port; must be given together with host unless alias is used.

container.description: Existing Docker container name or ID on the SSH host. All tools operate inside it; results return a full ID for reuse without another name lookup. No provisioning or managed allocation.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller connection limit in milliseconds; omitted by default.

runtime_env_file.description: Remote profile script sourced before commands when runtime_env is true.

alias.description: Name from the endpoint alias files.

session_id.description: Identifier of the running unified exec session (a JSON number up to 9007199254740991). A legacy larger numeric id cannot be sent here; use remote_job_status, remote_job_tail or remote_job_stdin with job_id or session_id as a string.

chars.description: Bytes to write to stdin. Defaults to empty, which polls without writing.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding output. Non-empty writes default to 250 ms and cap at 30000 ms; empty polls wait 5000-300000 ms by default.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token budget. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

remote.name: remote_view_image
remote.description: General remote tool for every native Codex task; no MindIE activation needed. The host binds native task identity per call; one task cannot reach another task's remote jobs. View an image file on the remote endpoint when visual inspection is needed (Codex view_image).

inputSchema.description: Provide at least one endpoint selector: host and port together, or an alias from the endpoint alias files. The server validates the selector before connecting.

host.description: SSH host; must be given together with port unless alias is used.

port.description: SSH port; must be given together with host unless alias is used.

container.description: Existing Docker container name or ID on the SSH host. All tools operate inside it; results return a full ID for reuse without another name lookup. No provisioning or managed allocation.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller connection limit in milliseconds; omitted by default.

runtime_env_file.description: Remote profile script sourced before commands when runtime_env is true.

alias.description: Name from the endpoint alias files.

path.description: Path to an image file on the remote endpoint (not a local path).
